data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 confines its distinguishing evidence to OOD/adversarial cases, but the problem asks for evidence within a single evaluation. OOD cases by definition fall outside that evaluation's distribution, so SRC_001 does not actually identify an evidence signal available in the single evaluation itself; it defers the discrimination to a shifted distribution the evaluation does not contain. A genuine single-evaluation signal would have to be internal to the original task set — e.g., item-level panel–expert disagreement patterns, correlation of checklist-step adherence with correctness, or calibration checks — rather than OOD probes that the single evaluation excludes.
